title: Subway poster pair
slide_intent: Compare adjacent executions in their actual setting, because an identity must connect different messages within environmental clutter.
strategic_value: The repeated right-edge MoMA signature can make two contrasting exhibition images read as a museum family.
demonstration: Two framed posters share a tiled subway wall. One contains a pale sideways portrait; the other combines monochrome figures, shovel and green bucket separated by plus signs.
practical_value: Check whether the repeated signature connects a single-image poster with a multi-image composition.

content_islands.name: Left poster
content_islands.spec: Place the pale portrait poster in its black frame at left with heading band above and MoMA strip at right.

content_islands.name: Right poster
content_islands.spec: Place the object sequence in the neighboring frame, keeping the plus signs and right-edge signature visible.

content_islands.name: Station setting
content_islands.spec: Retain the white tiled wall, red upper band and oblique viewing angle around both frames.

reference_purposes.Application: Pentagram identifies this installation as the Fifth Avenue and 53rd Street station near MoMA.
